messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold: | Step | What to Do | Why it Helps | |------|------------|--------------| | **1. Gather info** | Note brand, model, year, condition, any accessories (case, strap, picks). | Buyers want specifics; missing details can delay or lower offers. | | **2. Clean & tune** | Give it a good wash, polish, and tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more valuable and shows you care. | | **3. Take quality photos** | Shoot from multiple angles (front, back, neck, headstock, electronics if any). | Clear images reduce buyer questions and increase trust. | | **4. Set a realistic price** | Check listings on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, local music shops. | Competitive pricing attracts buyers while still giving you fair value. | | **5. Choose a platform** | • Reverb – great for gear, global reach.
• eBay – auction or fixed price, wide audience.
• Craigslist/Facebook Marketplace – local, no shipping hassles.
• Local music stores – consignment or direct sale. | Pick one that matches your urgency and desired audience. | | **6. Write a clear listing** | Include brand, model, year, condition, any flaws, accessories, and why you’re selling. | Transparency builds buyer confidence. | | **7. Handle inquiries promptly** | Respond quickly, offer to send extra photos or videos if requested. | Good communication speeds up the sale. | | **8. Negotiate wisely** | Decide your lowest acceptable price beforehand. | Keeps negotiations focused and prevents you from underselling. | | **9. Arrange safe payment** | For online sales, use PayPal Goods & Services or Venmo (if you trust the buyer). For local sales, cash or Venmo is safest. | Protects against fraud. | | **10. Ship or hand‑off safely** | Use a padded case or bubble wrap, insure if shipping. | Reduces damage risk and gives buyer peace of mind. | ### Quick Tips - **Highlight unique features** (e.g., custom finish, vintage status) to justify higher prices. - **Offer a demo video** if possible—shows tone and playability. - **Consider consignment** at a local shop if you don’t want to handle shipping or negotiations. Good luck with your sale! If you need help drafting a listing or setting a price, let me know.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice on selling an acoustic guitar. We need to respond with helpful information. There's no request for a function call. So we just answer.
